desc:
🚽 Toilets are invading the city! Build an army of Cameramen, Speakermen and TV Men and stop them before they reach your base.

🎲 Summon units from Basic to Mythic and hunt for rare ✨ Shiny versions
🛡️ Place units along the road and upgrade them up to level 7 to unlock new attacks
🔥 4 difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Insane (up to 50 waves)
👹 Bosses every 10 waves — the giant G-Toilet stuns your units with its laser eyes!
👥 Play solo or with friends — up to 4 players per match
🎓 New here? Finish the tutorial for a free Rare unit and 300 Coins

🎁 Code: RELEASE — 150 Coins
👥 Join our group to claim a free coin chest in the lobby every day!
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game to get notified about updates!

🎨 All assets in this game are original and were created by our team.
